note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Every guide is written in our own words from the cited source; where the exact steps are not yet confirmed by any guide site, the guide says so instead of inventing a location.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. There is no shortcut: the platinum pops the moment the last one lands, and the long pole is the Gold for 100% completion, so plan for roughly 200 hours and one full playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It unlocks as the story starts — just follow the opening beats until the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophies cannot be missed; keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophies cannot be missed; keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophies cannot be missed; keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophies cannot be missed; keep playing the main missions and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. After the credits you keep free-roam of Leonida, so nothing you need afterwards is locked away by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as part of the story — just play the main missions in order.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist — story 45%, exploration and activities 45%, discovery 10%. The thresholds are lenient, about 60% of true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the list is missable. The only tasks that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races, and Bret's quests.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 in Leonida — 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps — and any 250 count. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types on the map — play one round of each and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are two shooting range locations in Leonida; the golds are not too hard, so work through each challenge's list one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Drone races are also one of the few things the 100% checklist demands in full, so learn each course rather than rushing it.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat, or air — so spread them across the map instead of repeating one.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him in the challenge — steady reeling beats yanking the rod.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick any cabinet, and finish one full game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida; follow Andy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida; follow Kenton's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida; follow Billy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strands are the side-character quest lines marked on the map; finish any eight in full. They are not needed for 100% completion, so save them for the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida; follow Randy's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida; follow Tyrone's strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. Do the first one the morning after the Down to Earth mission, on the balcony at home in Chapter 1 — that spot is gone once the chapter ends, which makes this the only potentially missable trophy. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy, not the checklist, is the reason to be careful.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the few things the 100% checklist demands in full, so work through his strand and take the unique-animal hunt when it comes up.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida; finish any three. The 100% checklist asks for 15 of the 18, so keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone and scan unfamiliar vehicles and places as you travel — 100 distinct locations count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game and you may skip the hardest: 50 unlocks this trophy, 70 feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner — available once you can switch characters in Chapter 2 — build a 4-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and get clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive the whole run — plan the route first so you are not doubling back.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The WAiNK app logs each new vehicle you scan; 100 distinct discoveries pop the trophy, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five enemies before it ends — a tight group and a fast weapon make it far easier.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. The description points to stealing a plane and taking off without a flight plan — the exact steps are not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so treat this as the lead, not a verified method.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points at the Rhino tank — get into one and put it to use. The exact steps are not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so treat this as a lead, not a verified method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you — and get out clean. A stealth approach and a quick exit matter more than speed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, out of 8 in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission and always bring a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready before you crack the first one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it, and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Drive, fly, and sail until every region of the map is revealed — the map fills in as you travel, and the trophy pops when the last region opens.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida; hit one per gang and get away.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole hint: find a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. PowerPyx lists the exact steps as not yet known, so the precise spot is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. GTABase's best reading is to drive a car out through a showroom window — but PowerPyx lists the exact steps as not yet known, so treat the window escape as an unconfirmed lead.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by the guide sites, so the alley itself is the lead.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. You can start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break mission, when character switching opens. Buy a gym membership, train with your partner alongside you — call them in before you work out — and check Strength under the touchpad menu, then the character, then the heart icon. Both must be at maximum at the same time.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can watch the count by opening this trophy in the trophy list, and turning on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile) shows a small demon face whenever an action counts. Robberies, fights, and clean stealthy jobs all feed it — it fills up naturally as you play. Warning: the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so avoid pushing your profile to the bottom.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The game's hint is all anyone has: the guide sites list this trophy as unconfirmed, and the likeliest reading is a story moment that only lands on a second attempt. No verified method exists yet — play the story and watch for it rather than hunting a specific spot.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? GTABase suggests a strange random encounter somewhere in Leonida, and one early report points to a UFO encounter in Kelly County — but neither is confirmed, and PowerPyx lists the trophy as not yet known. Treat it as a random encounter to stumble into, not a destination.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The description points to knocking bowling pins over with a melee drive-by, but the exact conditions are not yet confirmed by the guide sites — the bowling alley is the place to try it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them through your laundering contacts and the total adds up across the whole game — keep robbing and keep laundering.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total counts across every shop in the game — clothes, weapons, food, and everything else — so normal shopping on the way to the platinum gets you most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property on the market across Leonida; the trophy pops with the last deed.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten vehicles worth keeping, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — ten registrations pops the trophy.
trophies.name: On the Spot
